## College-Age Population

### US Census Bureau/IPUMS

Get Your API Key Here: https://account.ipums.org/api_keys (Need to Register First)

```{python}
# Path to the cached master file
csv_path = Path("intermediate/Utah_Census_All_Age_Sex_1990_2023.csv")

# --- 1. Fetch & Cache Data (Only if missing) ---
if not csv_path.exists():
    print("Cached data not found. Fetching from NHGIS API...")

    # Initialize API
    load_dotenv()
    nhgis = IpumsApiClient(os.getenv("IPUMS_API_KEY"))

    # Define Data Configuration (Decennial + ACS 5-Year)
    data_config = [
        {"dataset": "1990_STF1", "table": "NP011"},
        {"dataset": "2000_SF1", "table": "NP012"},
        {"dataset": "2010_SF1", "table": "P12"},
        {"dataset": "2020_DHCA", "table": "P12"},
    ] + [{"dataset": f"{year}_ACS5", "table": "B01001"} for year in range(2009, 2024)]

    # Create Extract
    extract = NhgisExtract(
        description="Utah All Counties Sex-By-Age (1990-2023)",
        datasets=data_config,
        shapefiles=False,
        geog_levels=[
            {"name": "county", "filters": {"0490": None}}
        ],  # 0490 = Utah, None = All Counties
    )

    # Submit & Download
    nhgis.submit_extract(extract)
    print(f"Extract {extract.extract_id} processing...")
    nhgis.wait_for_extract(extract)

    # Read & Clean Headers
    # Row 0=Codes, Row 1=Descriptions. We use header=1 to get descriptions.
    content = nhgis.download_extract(extract)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content)) as z:
        with z.open(z.namelist()[0]) as f:
            df_raw = pd.read_csv(f, header=1)

    # Save Master File
    csv_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df_raw.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)
    print(f"Master file saved to: {csv_path}")

# --- 2. Load & Process ---
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

# Filter: Geography (Wasatch Front Counties)
target_counties = [
    "Box Elder County",
    "Weber County",
    "Davis County",
    "Salt Lake County",
    "Utah County",
]
df["County_Name"] = df["County"].str.title()
df_wfrc = df[df["County_Name"].isin(target_counties)].copy()

# Filter: Age Columns (18-24)
# Captures "18 and 19", "20", "21", "22 to 24", etc., excluding "Under 18"
age_keywords = ["18 and 19", "20 years", "21 years", "22 to 24"]
target_cols = [
    c
    for c in df.columns
    if any(k in str(c) for k in age_keywords) and "Under" not in str(c)
]

# Aggregate
for col in target_cols:
    df_wfrc[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_wfrc[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

df_wfrc["Population_18_24"] = df_wfrc[target_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Pivot for Final View
df_nhgis_college = (
    df_wfrc.pivot_table(
        index="Year", columns="County_Name", values="Population_18_24", aggfunc="sum"
    )
    .reset_index()
    .rename_axis(None, axis=1)
)

print("Historical College Age Population (1990-2023)")
display(df_nhgis_college)
```

### Forecast: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute

The following data was obtained from: https://d36oiwf74r1rap.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.pdf and converted to excel using https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/online/pdf-to-excel.html tool.

```{python}
# Table 1: Utah School-Age and College-Age Population, 2020-2060
# Note: School-age reflects population ages 5 to 17. College-age reflects population ages 18 to 24.
# Source: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute, 2020–2060 Projections
df_gpi_state_forecast = (
    pd.read_excel(
        "data/GPI/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.xlsx",
        sheet_name="Table 1",
        header=[51, 52],
        nrows=41,
    )
    .dropna(axis=1, how="all")
    .pipe(
        lambda d: d.set_axis(
            [
                "Year",
                "Total_Population",
                "School_Total",
                "School_Abs_Growth",
                "School_Growth_Rate",
                "School_Share",
                "College_Total",
                "College_Abs_Growth",
                "College_Growth_Rate",
                "College_Share",
            ],
            axis=1,
        )
    )
)

# Table 3: College-Age Population with Change by County, 2020 and 2060
# Note: College-age reflects population ages 18 to 24.
# Source: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute, 2020–2060 Projections
df_gpi_county_forecast = pd.read_excel(
    "data/GPI/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.xlsx", header=129, nrows=30
).dropna(axis=1, how="all")
```


```{python}
# Source: https://d36oiwf74r1rap.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Gardner-Policy-Institute-State-and-County-Projections-2025-2065-Data.xlsx

# List of target counties for the query
wftdm_counties = [
    "Box Elder County",
    "Weber County",
    "Davis County",
    "Salt Lake County",
    "Utah County",
]

df_gpi_projections = pd.read_excel(
    "data/GPI/Gardner-Policy-Institute-State-and-County-Projections-2025-2065-Data.xlsx",
    sheet_name="Demographic Detail",
    header=3,
    nrows=1230,
).query("Geography in @wftdm_counties")[["Geography", "Year", "Population Ages 18-24"]]

(
    df_gpi_projections.pivot(
        index="Year", columns="Geography", values="Population Ages 18-24"
    )
    .rename_axis(None, axis=1)  # Removes the "Geography" label from the columns
    .reset_index()  # Moves 'Year' from index to the first column
)
```
